evidence.quote: so I currently favor a 25-basis point increase at the FOMC's next meeting at the end of this month.
we still have a considerable way to go toward our 2 percent inflation goal, and I expect to support continued tightening of monetary policy.
Now, here's why I am cautious about these latest results and why I am not ready yet to substantially alter my outlook for inflation.
We do not want to be head-faked. I will be looking for the recent improvement in headline and core inflation to continue.
A robust labor market, despite modest economic growth, is a plus for workers and allows the Fed to focus on lowering inflation.
